observations: Photo 0: Laptop open, screen on, showing Windows desktop with a rock arch wallpaper. Keyboard and touchpad visible. Stickers on palm rest: 'MSI Alpha 17 C7V', NVIDIA GeForce RTX, AMD Ryzen, and others. Watermark 'RICKYICT TECH LTD' across image.
Photo 1: Laptop open, screen off, reflecting light. Same stickers visible on palm rest. Watermark present.
Photo 2: Laptop open, screen off, from slightly different angle. Same stickers visible. Watermark present.
All photos show a 17-inch laptop with a black chassis, full-size keyboard, and a large touchpad.
No visible damage to screen, keyboard, or body in any photo.
No ports, hinges, or underside visible.
No internal components or system specs visible.

The stickers show AMD Ryzen and NVIDIA GeForce RTX, but no specific model numbers for CPU or GPU. No SSD or RAM capacity visible. The claim of 'RTX 4070' and 'Ryzen 9' cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.risk: The laptop may not have the claimed specifications (Ryzen 9, RTX 4070, 1TB SSD, 16GB RAM).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information (Windows 'About' page or GPU-Z) showing CPU, GPU, RAM, and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-spec model or as not matching the advertised specs.

risks.risk: The laptop may have hidden physical damage or wear not visible in the photos (e.g., hinge issues, screen dead pixels, keyboard defects).
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop being opened and closed, screen being touched and moved, and keyboard being typed on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential hidden defects, reducing value.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be functional or may have software issues (e.g., not booting, Windows activation problems).
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop booting up, running a benchmark, and displaying system specs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with unknown functionality.

proof_requests: Screenshot of system information showing CPU, GPU, RAM, and storage details.
Video showing the laptop booting up and running normally.
Video showing the laptop being opened and closed, screen being touched, and keyboard being typed on.
response.reason: The model is identifiable as MSI Alpha 17 C7V from stickers, but the seller's claims about specific components (Ryzen 9, RTX 4070, 1TB SSD, 16GB RAM) cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks include incorrect specs, physical damage, and functionality issues. Proof is needed to confirm the claims and assess the true value.
